result:
Done. I've set up autostart for the sync in two steps:

**1. Created `scripts/autostart.ps1`** — a wrapper that runs the sync and logs output to `data/autostart.log`

**2. Created a Windows Startup shortcut** — placed at `%APPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\Startup\SentinelAutoSync.lnk`

Now whenever the box reboots, Windows will automatically launch this shortcut at login, which runs `scripts/sync.sh`. Output and any errors log to `data/autostart.log` so you can see if something went wrong.

The setup uses your user Startup folder (no admin required) and will persist across reboots.
